title: Understanding NABL Calibration: Why It Matters for Your Lab
author: Accurion Technical Team
excerpt: Explore why ISO/IEC 17025 accredited calibration is essential for CTMs, balances, sieves, and proving rings to ensure legal compliance and testing accuracy.
body:
If you operate a civil quality laboratory in India, you've likely heard the term 'NABL calibration.' NABL stands for the National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories, the apex accreditation body in India under ISO/IEC 17025.

Without regular calibration, even the most expensive testing equipment can drift out of specification over time — giving you incorrect test results without you knowing it.
seo_description: Complete guide to NABL calibration for civil testing labs. Learn why ISO/IEC 17025 calibration is essential for CTMs, balances, proving rings, and sieves.
